summary_1line: Bhishma explains the sacred supremacy of cows, recounting Brahma’s teaching to Indra and the austerities of Surabhi that led to the exalted realm of Goloka.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a celestial assembly filled with gods, sages, and dancers, Indra bows before Brahma and asks why the realm of cows stands above the heavens.
The divine cow Surabhi stands on one leg in severe penance atop Mount Kailasa for thousands of years as gods and serpents gather in awe.
Brahma grants Surabhi immortality and a radiant realm called Goloka above the three worlds while celestial beings look on.
